name: fundrivendev
description: Public Claude Code plugins by FunDrivenDev

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Context-budget status line: tokens against the auto-compact trigger, prompt-cache countdown, quota pace, git branch and PR, plus plugin segments.

plugins.name: session-panel
plugins.description: A calm side pane: model and effort, first prompt, uptime, prompt-cache countdown, sub-agents with their task and full history, and a checklist of the session's steps.

plugins.name: handover
plugins.description: Hand a session over to a fresh one before its context fills up: a separate model writes the handover from the transcript, /clear loads it

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Understand a codebase: systematic exploration report and DDD ubiquitous-language glossary (discover, refresh)

plugins.name: tool
plugins.description: Workflow tooling: wrap-up report (artifact, Bear, Slack), MCP server audit, Claude config audit, and local-LLM setup advice
